issues.description: Ride attribute visibility mismatch: The UML specifies both Ride attributes (-name: String, -abbreviation: char) as private, but the solution declares `name` as `public` while `abbreviation` is `private`. This contradicts the specification and undermines the intended encapsulation/getter-only access pattern.
issues.suggestedFix: In `src/de/tum/in/ase/Ride.java`, change `public String name;` to `private String name;` to match the UML, and keep access via `getName()`.
